description: Create a deterministic FidelityCopy receipt for exact copy work. AI may request the copy, but this tool computes source/output hashes and returns PASS only when the selected mode proves exact or approved fidelity.

copyroom_source_packet.description: CopyRoom source packet used as the source of truth. Mutually exclusive with source_text/source_base64.

encoding.description: CopyRoom v1 encoding. Defaults to utf8.

newline_policy.description: CopyRoom v1 newline policy. Defaults to preserve.

destination_label.description: Human label for the output destination when output_ref is not supplied.

output_base64.description: Output bytes for approved_transform mode as base64.

output_ref.description: Output pointer used in the receipt.

provenance_ref.description: Optional Boardroom, issue, PR, or CopyRoom pointer for audit trail.

source_base64.description: Exact source bytes as base64. Mutually exclusive with source_text.

source_ref.description: Source pointer used in the receipt.

source_text.description: Exact source text to copy. Mutually exclusive with source_base64.

name: fidelitycopy_copy
